name: pyjinhx-syntax-support
description: Syntax highlighting and template formatting for the PyJinHx Python framework (PascalCase component tags, slots, {#def#} headers, interpolation).

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package

pyjinhx.pythonPath.markdownDescription: The Python interpreter that has pyjinhx installed. Empty: the Python extension's environment, then `.venv` in the workspace folder, then `python3` on `PATH`. `${workspaceFolder}` is replaced.

pyjinhx.generateStubs.markdownDescription: Write `<name>.pyi` beside each `.pjx` with a `{#python` block, as `python -m pyjinhx.stubgen` does, when the manifest reports it missing or stale.

enumDescriptions: Format the body with the project's ruff.
Leave the body as it is.
pyjinhx.format.python.markdownDescription: How the formatter treats the body of a `{#python` block. `ruff` runs `ruff format` on it, found as `<interpreter> -m ruff` (the interpreter of `pyjinhx.pythonPath`), then as `ruff` on `PATH`, with the project's own ruff configuration; the imports are sorted first (see `pyjinhx.format.sortImports`). Without ruff, on a body ruff cannot parse, and in an untrusted workspace the body is left as it is.

pyjinhx.format.sortImports.markdownDescription: Sort the imports of a `{#python` block when it is formatted, with ruff's import sorting (rule `I001`) and the project's `[tool.ruff.lint.isort]` settings. No other lint fix is applied. Ignored when `pyjinhx.format.python` is `off`.

pyjinhx.format.css.markdownDescription: Format the body of `{#css` blocks and `<style>` elements with the editor's CSS formatter, using its `css.format.*` settings and the editor's indentation. A body with Jinja in it is left as it is.

pyjinhx.format.js.markdownDescription: Format the body of `{#js` blocks and `<script>` elements with the editor's JavaScript formatter, using its `javascript.format.*` settings and the editor's indentation. A body with Jinja in it, and a `<script>` whose `type` is not JavaScript, is left as it is. The first use starts the editor's JavaScript service.

pyjinhx.pythonBlock.enabled.markdownDescription: Colours, hover, definition, completion and signature help inside `{#python` blocks, from a private basedpyright process started when a `.pjx` with a block is open. Uses about 300 MB of memory.

pyjinhx.pythonBlock.serverPath.markdownDescription: Another `langserver.index.js` of basedpyright to run instead of the bundled one.

pyjinhx.pythonBlock.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Show basedpyright's diagnostics for the lines of a `{#python` block. basedpyright reads the project's `pyrightconfig.json`, `[tool.pyright]` or `[tool.basedpyright]`; see `typeCheckingMode`.

pyjinhx.pythonBlock.typeCheckingMode.markdownDescription: The checking mode for `{#python` blocks, used only when the project has no `pyrightconfig.json`, no `[tool.pyright]` and no `[tool.basedpyright]`. With any of those, basedpyright ignores this setting, and a config that sets no `typeCheckingMode` gets basedpyright's own, louder `recommended`: set `typeCheckingMode` in the project config.

pyjinhx.manifest.paths.description: Folders or files to read components from, relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the whole folder.

pyjinhx.manifest.sysPath.description: Directories modules are imported from (`--sys-path`), relative to the workspace folder; they decide how a component's module is named.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace no Python interpreter and no ruff is run: tags and props come from the .pjx files only, and {#python bodies are not formatted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Manifest features need a local Python; highlighting and HTML/CSS/JS forwarding work.
